verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official MCP server, AI Assistant in the dashboard, and discoverable agent-skills catalog, allowing natural-language operation of database, auth, functions, storage, etc. via AI assistants; runtime probes confirm the MCP endpoint and skills index are live and functioning. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that complex multi-step natural-language commands work reliably end-to-end, and community evidence raises unresolved prompt-injection/security concerns around MCP tool use that add caveats to trustworthiness.
